instruction.text: Complete the sentence with the correct spelling of the word.

atoms.b: The racer finished in fourth ((++position postion poistion posture)).
atoms.finishSound: The racer finished in fourth position.

atoms.b: Some kids have to be kept ((++separate seprate separte september)).
atoms.finishSound: Some kids have to be kept separate.

atoms.b: Would you like to try a ((++different diferent deterrent diffrent)) shoe?
atoms.finishSound: Would you like to try a different shoe?

atoms.b: Don’t put so much ((++pressure presure preasure prassure)) on me!
atoms.finishSound: Don’t put so much pressure on me!

atoms.b: To be or not to be, that is the ((++question quession qestion questure)).
atoms.finishSound: To be or not to be, that is the question.

atoms.b: ((++Remember Remembre Rember Rememper)), ((++remember remembre rember rememper)) the fifth of November.
atoms.finishSound: Remember, remember, the fifth of November.

atoms.b: You should ((++probably probly prolly probaply)) drink more water.
atoms.finishSound: You should probably drink more water.
